ground.$description: The sheet the form is printed on. Cool, chroma at or near zero. Named `ground` and not paper/bone/cream deliberately: those names are themselves the tell, and the warm near-white they describe is the coordinate S0 §4.6 closed and the revoked lock sat on.

000.$description: the blank itself — the one place with nothing printed on it

200.$description: a panel set into the page

ink.$description: Printed matter. 500 is the floor: anything lighter fails AA at the sizes metadata is actually set in, which is exactly how all four S1 boards shipped 3.2–3.5:1 captions.

500.$description: tertiary floor — 5.45:1 on ground.100. There is no 400, and adding one reopens the defect.

pen.$description: Ballpoint blue: the mark a 원장 makes on a sheet that is already printed. It is an ink, not a brand accent, and it is painted only where something gets filled in.

300.$description: the stroke lifted to read on ink.900

100.$description: a filled blank seen from across the page

output.$description: One ink per kind of thing the book produces. These are roles, not decoration: a colour here names a document type, so a fifth colour requires a fifth document type. They exist because the hero claims the output is not one thing.

exam.$description: 시험지 한 부 — the default output; shares the pen's ink rather than inventing a second blue
